## Homeowner in Need of Cash? Open a HELOC at VNB


Do you own your home? Could you use some extra cash for home improvements or paying off bills? You may be eligible to apply for a Home Equity Line of Credit (HELOC) at Virginia National Bank.


Our latest podcast episode with VNB’s Chief Banking Officer, Gina Bayes, and Chief Credit Officer, Caleb Moore, will explain what a HELOC is and if you qualify. Listen to the interview here.


### Follow[Virginia National Bank: My Forever Bank](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/virginia-national-bank-my-forever-bank/id6805109463) wherever you listen to podcasts.


##


*The term of a HELOC is 25 years. The Annual Percentage Rate (APR) is variable and is based upon an index plus a margin. The APR will vary with the Prime Rate (the index) as published in the Wall Street Journal. The APR is variable during the 10-year draw period and 15-year repayment period and is based on your credit line amount, combined Loan-To-Value (CLTV) ratio and other factors. During the 15-year repayment period, the APR will continue to be calculated at a variable rate and your minimum monthly payment will be 1/180th of the total balance at the end of the draw period, plus interest and any applicable fees/charges. Virginia National Bank will pay up to $2,000 toward closing costs. If you terminate your account within 36 months of opening it, you will be required to remit any closing costs the Bank paid on your behalf. This product is subject to credit approval and is based on a minimum equity line amount of $25,000 with a maximum combined loan-to-value of 80%. This product is limited to an owner-occupied single-family residential property. You must carry property insurance on the property that secures the loan. HELOC offers are subject to change without notice at any time. The interest rate on a Home Equity Line of Credit may be tax deductible. Consult your tax advisor regarding deductibility of interest.*
